# Setup

Install `dodo` (if needed):

```{r install-dodo, output=FALSE}
renv::install("Louis-Backstrom/dodo@development")
```

```{r dodo-version}
cat("Using dodo version", as.character(packageVersion("dodo")))
```

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(dodo)
library(tidyverse)
library(future)
library(furrr)
library(ggh4x)
```

Set up parallel processing:

```{r setup-parallel}
plan(multisession, workers = floor(availableCores() * 0.5))
# plan(sequential)
```

Set key parameters:

```{r overwrite}
overwrite <- FALSE
```

```{r parameters}
alpha <- 0.05
beta <- 0.2

# Vary
gs <- seq(0, 20, by = 2)

# Keep Constant
extinction_time <- 100
test_times <- seq(0, 100, by = 1) + extinction_time

pse <- 0.175
theta_max <- c(1, 10)
lambda <- c(1, 1)

# Grids
iterations_extinct <- 1:50
iterations_extant <- 1:10000

grid_extinct <- expand_grid(
  iteration = iterations_extinct,
  test_time = test_times,
  g = gs
)
grid_extant <- expand_grid(
  iteration = iterations_extant,
  g = gs
)
```

Set up functions for records:

```{r functions}
create_records <- function(extinction_time, pse, test_time) {
  repeat {
    counts <- rpois(extinction_time, pse)
    if (any(counts[1:test_time] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) break
  }

  records <- rep(seq_along(counts), counts)
  records <- data.frame(time = records, p_ci_min = 1, p_ci = 1, p_ci_max = 1)

  records <- convert_dodo(records,
    init.time = 1, test.time = test_time,
    threshold = 0.9, unique = FALSE, aggregate = "max",
    time = "time", certainty = "p_ci",
    certainty_lower = "p_ci_min",
    certainty_upper = "p_ci_max"
  )

  return(records$cdis)
}
```

Set up functions for models:

```{r model-functions}
run_model <- function(records, alpha, test_time, g) {
  out <- BA26B1(
    records = records, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1, test.time = test_time,
    priors = list(theta_max = theta_max, g = g, lambda = lambda),
    n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
  )

  return(out)
}

test_model <- function(output, alpha) {
  return(output$p.extant < alpha)
}
```

Set up output directories:

```{r directories}
dir.create(file.path("Outputs", "Tests", "Prior Lag", "Extinct"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(file.path("Outputs", "Tests", "Prior Lag", "Extant"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

# Run

Generate datasets:

```{r generate-datasets}
set.seed(1234)

data_extinct <- grid_extinct %>%
  mutate(data = future_pmap(
    list(test_time, iteration),
    function(test_time, iteration) {
      records <- create_records(extinction_time, pse, test_time)
      return(records)
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  ))

stopifnot(nrow(data_extinct) == nrow(grid_extinct))
saveRDS(data_extinct, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extinct/simulated_datasets.rds")

data_extant <- grid_extant %>%
  mutate(data = future_pmap(
    list(iteration),
    function(iteration) {
      records <- create_records(extinction_time, pse, extinction_time)
      return(records)
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  ))

stopifnot(nrow(data_extant) == nrow(grid_extant))
saveRDS(data_extant, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extant/simulated_datasets.rds")
```

Run models:

```{r run-extinct}
model_file <- "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extinct/output.rds"

valid_file <- FALSE
if (file.exists(model_file)) {
  check <- readRDS(model_file)
  if (!is.null(check) && nrow(check) == nrow(grid_extinct)) {
    valid_file <- TRUE
  }
  rm(check)
}

if (!valid_file || overwrite == TRUE) {
  results <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(grid_extinct)), function(idx) {
    test_time <- grid_extinct$test_time[idx]
    g <- grid_extinct$g[idx]
    iteration <- grid_extinct$iteration[idx]

    data_i <- data_extinct$data[[idx]]

    iteration_start <- Sys.time()

    warning_msg <- character()
    error_msg <- NA_character_

    output <- tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(
        run_model(records = data_i, alpha = alpha, test_time = test_time, g = g),
        warning = function(w) {
          warning_msg <<- c(warning_msg, conditionMessage(w))
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        }
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        error_msg <<- conditionMessage(e)
        NULL
      }
    )

    i_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), iteration_start, units = "secs") %>%
      as.numeric()

    result <- if (is.null(output)) {
      tibble(
        iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time, g = g,
        isextinct = NA, warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = TRUE,
        warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
          paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
        error_msg = if (length(error_msg) > 0) {
          paste(unique(error_msg), collapse = " | ")
        } else {
          NA_character_
        }, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time, g = g,
        isextinct = test_model(output, alpha),
        warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = FALSE,
        warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
          paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
        error_msg = NA_character_, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
      )
    }

    result <- result %>%
      mutate(worker_pid = Sys.getpid())

    rm(output)
    gc()

    return(result)
  }, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

  all_results <- bind_rows(results)

  saveRDS(all_results, model_file)
}
```

```{r run-extant}
model_file <- "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extant/output.rds"

valid_file <- FALSE
if (file.exists(model_file)) {
  check <- readRDS(model_file)
  if (!is.null(check) && nrow(check) == nrow(grid_extant)) {
    valid_file <- TRUE
  }
  rm(check)
}

if (!valid_file || overwrite == TRUE) {
  results <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(grid_extant)), function(idx) {
    g <- grid_extant$g[idx]
    iteration <- grid_extant$iteration[idx]

    data_i <- data_extant$data[[idx]]

    iteration_start <- Sys.time()

    warning_msg <- character()
    error_msg <- NA_character_

    output <- tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(
        run_model(records = data_i, alpha = alpha, test_time = extinction_time, g = g),
        warning = function(w) {
          warning_msg <<- c(warning_msg, conditionMessage(w))
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        }
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        error_msg <<- conditionMessage(e)
        NULL
      }
    )

    i_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), iteration_start, units = "secs") %>%
      as.numeric()

    result <- if (is.null(output)) {
      tibble(
        iteration = iteration, g = g, last_time = max(which(data_i > 0)),
        isextinct = NA, warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = TRUE,
        warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
          paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
        } else {

        },
        error_msg = if (length(error_msg) > 0) {
          paste(unique(error_msg), collapse = " | ")
        } else {
          NA_character_
        }, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        iteration = iteration, g = g, last_time = max(which(data_i > 0)),
        isextinct = test_model(output, alpha),
        warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = FALSE,
        warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
          paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
        error_msg = NA_character_, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
      )
    }

    result <- result %>%
      mutate(worker_pid = Sys.getpid())

    rm(output)
    gc()

    return(result)
  }, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

  all_results <- bind_rows(results)

  saveRDS(all_results, model_file)
}
```

# Accuracy

```{r accuracy-extinct}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
results_extinct <- readRDS("Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extinct/output.rds")

summary_extinct <- results_extinct %>%
  group_by(g, test_time, isextinct) %>%
  tally() %>%
  group_by(g, test_time) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

predictions_extinct <- tibble(
  g = numeric(),
  test_time = integer(),
  lci = numeric(),
  fit = numeric(),
  uci = numeric()
)

thresholds_extinct <- tibble(
  g = gs,
  threshold = NA_real_
)

for (g_i in gs) {
  estimates <- results_extinct %>%
    filter(g == g_i)

  accuracy_model_i <- glm(
    data = estimates,
    formula = isextinct ~ test_time,
    family = "binomial"
  )

  prediction_i <- predict(accuracy_model_i, newdata = data.frame(
    test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times)
  ), se.fit = TRUE) %>%
    bind_cols(data.frame(test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times)), .) %>%
    mutate(
      lci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.025) * se.fit),
      uci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.975) * se.fit),
      fit = plogis(fit),
      g = g_i
    ) %>%
    select(g, test_time, lci, fit, uci)

  predictions_extinct <- bind_rows(predictions_extinct, prediction_i)

  threshold <- (qlogis(1 - beta) - accuracy_model_i$coefficients[1]) /
    accuracy_model_i$coefficients[2]

  if (threshold < extinction_time) {
    threshold <- extinction_time
  }

  thresholds_extinct[thresholds_extinct$g == g_i, ]$threshold <- threshold
}

thresholds_extinct <- thresholds_extinct %>%
  mutate(g = factor(g))

saveRDS(thresholds_extinct, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extinct/thresholds_extinct.rds")

predictions_extinct <- predictions_extinct %>%
  mutate(g = factor(g))

saveRDS(predictions_extinct, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extinct/predictions_extinct.rds")

plot_extinct <- ggplot() +
  # geom_ribbon(
  #   data = predictions_extinct,
  #   aes(x = test_time, ymin = lci, ymax = uci),
  #   alpha = 0.2
  # ) +
  geom_line(
    data = predictions_extinct,
    aes(x = test_time, y = fit),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_extinct,
    aes(x = test_time, y = isextinct, size = prop)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = thresholds_extinct,
    aes(xintercept = threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = thresholds_extinct,
    aes(yintercept = 1 - beta),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(extinction_time, extinction_time * 2),
    breaks = c(extinction_time, extinction_time * 1.5, extinction_time * 2),
    expand = c(0.1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Test Time (Extinction at Time ", extinction_time, ")"),
    y = "Power"
  )

plot_extinct +
  facet_wrap2(~g,
    drop = FALSE, ncol = 5, nrow = 4,
    axes = "all", remove_labels = "all"
  )
```

```{r accuracy-extant}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
results_extant <- readRDS("Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extant/output.rds")

summary_extant <- results_extant %>%
  group_by(g, last_time, isextinct) %>%
  tally() %>%
  group_by(g, last_time) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

predictions_extant <- tibble(
  g = numeric(),
  last_time = integer(),
  lci = numeric(),
  fit = numeric(),
  uci = numeric()
)

thresholds_extant <- tibble(
  g = gs,
  threshold = NA_real_
)

for (g_i in gs) {
  estimates <- results_extant %>%
    filter(g == g_i)

  accuracy_model_i <- glm(
    data = estimates,
    formula = isextinct ~ last_time,
    family = "binomial"
  )

  prediction_i <- predict(accuracy_model_i, newdata = data.frame(
    last_time = 0:extinction_time
  ), se.fit = TRUE) %>%
    bind_cols(data.frame(last_time = 0:extinction_time), .) %>%
    mutate(
      lci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.025) * se.fit),
      uci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.975) * se.fit),
      fit = plogis(fit),
      g = g_i
    ) %>%
    select(g, last_time, lci, fit, uci)

  predictions_extant <- bind_rows(predictions_extant, prediction_i)

  threshold <- (qlogis(alpha) - accuracy_model_i$coefficients[1]) /
    accuracy_model_i$coefficients[2]

  if (threshold > extinction_time) {
    if (threshold > 1e6) {
      threshold <- 0
    } else {
      threshold <- extinction_time
    }
  } else if (threshold < 0) {
    threshold <- 0
  }

  thresholds_extant[thresholds_extant$g == g_i, ]$threshold <- threshold
}

thresholds_extant <- thresholds_extant %>%
  mutate(g = factor(g))

saveRDS(thresholds_extant, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extant/thresholds.rds")

predictions_extant <- predictions_extant %>%
  mutate(g = factor(g))

saveRDS(predictions_extant, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extant/predictions_extant.rds")

error_rates <- results_extant %>%
  group_by(g, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(error_rate = mean(isextinct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(g = factor(g))

saveRDS(error_rates, "Outputs/Tests/Prior Lag/Extant/error_rates.rds")

plot_extant <- ggplot() +
  # geom_ribbon(
  #   data = predictions,
  #   aes(x = last_time, ymin = lci, ymax = uci),
  #   alpha = 0.2
  # ) +
  geom_line(
    data = predictions_extant,
    aes(x = last_time, y = fit),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_extant,
    aes(x = last_time, y = isextinct, size = prop)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = thresholds_extant,
    aes(xintercept = threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = thresholds_extant,
    aes(yintercept = alpha),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = error_rates,
    aes(label = scales::percent(error_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    x = extinction_time * 0.5, y = alpha * 2,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(extinction_time * 0.5, extinction_time),
    breaks = c(extinction_time * 0.5, extinction_time * 0.75, extinction_time),
    expand = c(0.1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Time of Last Sighting (Test Time at ", extinction_time, ")"),
    y = "Type I Error Rate"
  )

plot_extant +
  facet_wrap2(~g,
    drop = FALSE, ncol = 5, nrow = 4,
    axes = "all", remove_labels = "all"
  )
```

# Comparison

```{r comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 4
prior_lag <- left_join(thresholds_extinct, error_rates, by = "g")

comparison_plot <- ggplot(prior_lag) +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = threshold, y = error_rate),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = threshold, y = error_rate),
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(extinction_time, extinction_time * 1.4),
    breaks = seq(extinction_time, extinction_time * 1.4,
      by = extinction_time / 10
    ),
    labels = function(x) {
      x - extinction_time
    },
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.2), breaks = seq(0, 0.2, by = 0.05)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Prior Lag",
    x = paste0(
      "Time to Achieve ", (1 - beta) * 100,
      "% Power\n(After Extinction)"
    ),
    y = "Average Type I Error Rate"
  )

comparison_plot
```
